title: Artaxerxes
summary: Raleigh names Artaxerxes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Artaxerxes, the name prophane Historians giue the king whom the Scriptures call Artashasht. The passage does not say Longimanus or Mnemon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIII, §. IV, sig. 339a–339b
